## Population summary

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source("plotting-utils.R")

EPSILON <- 0.50
LABEL_SHIFT <- -0.05
N_THETA <- 201
N_ALPHA <- 51

output_dir <- file.path("sim-results")
replication_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("simulation_replications_eps%.2f_c%.2f.csv", EPSILON, LABEL_SHIFT))
summary_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("simulation_summary_eps%.2f_c%.2f.csv", EPSILON, LABEL_SHIFT))
if (!file.exists(replication_file) || !file.exists(summary_file)) {
  stop("Simulation CSVs not found. Run simulation_design.py first or set output_dir.")
}

dev_pdf <- function (filename, width, height, .path = "figures") {
  if (!dir.exists(.path)) {
    dir.create(.path, mode = '0755', recursive = TRUE)
  }
  if (isTRUE(capabilities('cairo'))) {
    cairo_pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
              fallback_resolution = 600,
              antialias = 'default',
              width = width,
              height = height)
  } else {
    pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
        width = width,
        height = height)
  }
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width  = 6,
                      fig.height = 2,
                      out.width  = "100%",
                      dev        = c('png', 'dev_pdf'),
                      fig.ext    = c('png', 'pdf'),
                      echo       = FALSE,
                      warning    = FALSE,
                      error      = FALSE,
                      message    = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
replications <- read_csv(replication_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(geometry = factor(geometry, levels = c("kl_kl", "hd_hd"), labels = c("KL/KL", "HD/HD")))

population_summary <- read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(geometry = factor(geometry, levels = c("kl_kl", "hd_hd"), labels = c("KL/KL", "HD/HD")))

alpha_values <- sort(unique(replications$alpha))
design <- population_summary |>
  distinct(epsilon, label_shift, delta, sample_size, target_sample_size)
if (nrow(design) != 1) {
  stop("Expected one fixed simulation design in the summary CSV.")
}

ratio_range <- (1 + design$epsilon) / (1 - design$epsilon)
hellinger_covariate <- 2 - 2 * ((1 + design$epsilon)^(3 / 2) - (1 - design$epsilon)^(3 / 2)) / (3 * design$epsilon)
log_moment <- function (alpha, epsilon) {
  lower <- 1 - design$epsilon
  upper <- 1 + design$epsilon
  power <- alpha + 1
  log((upper^power - lower^power) / (2 * design$epsilon * power))
}

radius_curves <- crossing(
  geometry = unique(population_summary$geometry),
  alpha = alpha_values
) |>
  left_join(population_summary, join_by(geometry)) |>
  mutate(
    lower_ratio = 1 - epsilon,
    upper_ratio = 1 + epsilon,
    ratio_range = upper_ratio / lower_ratio,
    hellinger_covariate = 2 - 2 * (upper_ratio^(3 / 2) - lower_ratio^(3 / 2)) / (3 * epsilon),
    power = alpha + 1,
    log_moment = log_moment(alpha, epsilon),
    derivative = (upper_ratio^power * log(upper_ratio) - lower_ratio^power * log(lower_ratio)) /
      (upper_ratio^power - lower_ratio^power) - 1 / power,
    normalizer = 1 - alpha * (1 - alpha) * hellinger_covariate,
    source_radius = if_else(
      geometry == "KL/KL",
      pmax(alpha * derivative - log_moment, 0),
      pmax(2 - (2 - alpha * hellinger_covariate) / sqrt(normalizer), 0)
    ),
    target_radius = if_else(
      geometry == "KL/KL",
      pmax((alpha - 1) * derivative - log_moment, 0),
      pmax(2 - (2 - (1 - alpha) * hellinger_covariate) / sqrt(normalizer), 0)
    ),
    kappa = log(80 * N_ALPHA * N_THETA / delta),
    lambda_n = 2 * sqrt(18 * kappa / (sample_size - 1)) + 30 * kappa / (sample_size - 1),
    sensitivity = if_else(
      geometry == "KL/KL",
      ratio_range^alpha,
      ((1 - alpha + alpha * sqrt(upper_ratio)) /
        (1 - alpha + alpha * sqrt(lower_ratio)))^2
    ),
    risk_envelope = if_else(
      geometry == "KL/KL",
      2 * sqrt(target_radius / 2) + 2 * sqrt(delta_target_label / 2) + 2 * sensitivity * lambda_n,
      2 * sqrt(target_radius) + 2 * sqrt(delta_target_label) + 2 * sensitivity * lambda_n
    ),
    population_ess = if_else(
      geometry == "KL/KL",
      exp(2 * log_moment - log_moment(2 * alpha, epsilon)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    population_ess = {
      # First for hd/hd
      delta_h <- 2 - 2 * (upper_ratio^(3 / 2) - lower_ratio^(3 / 2)) / (3 * epsilon)
      normalizer <- 1 - alpha * (1 - alpha) * delta_h
      second_moment <- map2_dbl(alpha, epsilon, \(a, e) {
        integrate(
          \(x) (1 - a + a * sqrt(1 + e * (2 * x - 1)))^4,
          lower = 0,
          upper = 1,
          rel.tol = 1e-11
        )$value
      })
      normalizer^2 / second_moment
    },
    population_ess = if_else(geometry == 'KL/KL',
                             exp(2 * log_moment - log_moment(2 * alpha, epsilon)),
                             population_ess))

risk_summary <- replications |>
  group_by(geometry, alpha) |>
  summarize(
    mean_excess_risk = mean(target_excess_risk),
    q10 = quantile(target_excess_risk, 0.10),
    q90 = quantile(target_excess_risk, 0.90),
    mean_ess = mean(ess_fraction),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

risk_curves <- risk_summary |>
  left_join(
    select(radius_curves, geometry, alpha, risk_envelope, population_ess),
    join_by(geometry, alpha)
  )

radius_long <- radius_curves |>
  select(geometry, alpha, source_radius, target_radius) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(source_radius, target_radius),
    names_to = "radius_type",
    values_to = "radius"
  ) |>
  mutate(radius_type = recode(radius_type,
                              source_radius = "Source radius",
                              target_radius = "Target radius"))

min_target_excess_risk <- risk_curves |> 
  group_by(geometry) |> 
  filter(mean_excess_risk < min(mean_excess_risk) + .Machine$double.eps) |> 
  ungroup()

risk_envelope_scale <- with(risk_curves, max(q90, na.rm = TRUE) / max(risk_envelope, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#| label: simulation-summary-table
#| tbl-cap: "Population quantities and selected bridge parameters."
population_summary |>
  select(
    geometry,
    delta_target_label,
    rho_source,
    rho_target,
    alpha_lower,
    alpha_min_mean_excess_risk,
    alpha_min_risk_envelope,
    endpoint_slope_margin
  ) |> 
  mutate(covariate_shift_epsilon = EPSILON,
         label_shift_c = LABEL_SHIFT) |> 
  left_join(min_target_excess_risk |> 
              select(geometry, mean_excess_risk, mean_ess, risk_envelope, population_ess),
            join_by(geometry)) |> 
  select(geometry, covariate_shift_epsilon, label_shift_c, everything()) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -geometry, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = geometry, values_from = value) |> 
  mutate(parameter = recode_values(
    parameter,
    "covariate_shift_epsilon" ~ "Covariate shift (𝜀)",
    "label_shift_c" ~ "Label shift (c)",
    "delta_target_label" ~ "Target label radius",
    "rho_source" ~ "Source radius",
    "rho_target" ~ "Target radius",
    "alpha_lower" ~ "Admissible lower alpha",
    "alpha_min_mean_excess_risk" ~ "Risk-minimizing alpha",
    "alpha_min_risk_envelope" ~ "Envelope-minimizing alpha",
    "endpoint_slope_margin" ~ "Endpoint-slope margin",
    "mean_excess_risk" ~ "Mean target excess risk at risk-minimizing alpha",
    "mean_ess" ~ "Mean ESS fraction at risk-minimizing alpha",
    "risk_envelope" ~ "Risk-bound envelope at risk-minimizing alpha",
    "population_ess" ~ "Population ESS fraction at risk-minimizing alpha")) |> 
  kbl(align = 'lrr') |> 
  kable_styling()
```

## Simulation profiles

```{r}
#| label: bounded-overlap-simulation-plot
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: >
#|  Exact radius profiles (top), realized target excess risk (middle) and effective sample size (bottom)
#|  for the KL/KL and HD/HD bridges. The risk-bound envelope uses the right-hand scale.
#|  The shaded interval in the radius profile plot denotes the admissible bridge range.
#|  Dashed horizontal lines in the radius row mark the true source and target radii and
#|  the dotted vertical lines mark the lower admissible endpoint.
#|  The shaded regions in the risk panels show the 10th and 90th percentiles of the Monte Carlo risk.
radius_plot <- population_summary |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = alpha_lower, xmax = alpha_upper, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = COLORPAL[["green"]],
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_text(data = tibble(geometry = unique(population_summary$geometry),
                          alpha = c(0.5, 0.51),
                          radius = c(0.043, 0.03),
                          label = "Admissible bridge range"),
            aes(x = alpha, y = radius, label = label),
            hjust = 0,
            size = 2.8,
            color = COLORPAL[["green"]]
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = radius_long,
    aes(x = alpha, y = radius, color = radius_type),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = rho_source),
    color = COLORPAL[["blue"]],
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = rho_target),
    color = COLORPAL[["orange"]],
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = alpha_lower),
    color = COLORPAL[["green"]],
    linetype = "11",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(geometry), nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Source radius" = COLORPAL[["blue"]],
    "Target radius" = COLORPAL[["orange"]]
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = expansion(),
                     labels = c("0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8", "1")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Radius", color = NULL) +
  plottheme() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.115, 0.80),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 1),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = 'gray20', linewidth = 0.3))

risk_plot <- risk_curves |> 
  ggplot(aes(alpha, mean_excess_risk)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q10, ymax = q90, ), fill = COLORPAL[["magenta"]], alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_line(aes(color = "Avg. target excess risk", linetype = "Avg. target excess risk"),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = risk_envelope * risk_envelope_scale,
        color = "Risk-bound envelope", linetype = "Risk-bound envelope"),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(data = min_target_excess_risk,
             aes(xintercept = alpha),
             color = COLORPAL[["magenta"]], linetype = "11", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(geometry), nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = expansion(),
                     labels = c("0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8", "1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Target excess risk",
    expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02), 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / risk_envelope_scale, name = "Risk-bound envelope")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "22")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c("magenta", "black")])) +
  labs(x = NULL, linetype = NULL, color = NULL) +
  plottheme() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.155, 0.81),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 1),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = 'gray20', linewidth = 0.3))

ess_plot <- risk_curves |>
  select(geometry, alpha, ends_with('ess')) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_ess, population_ess), names_to = "ess_type", values_to = "ess") |> 
    mutate(ess_type = recode_values(ess_type,
                                    "mean_ess" ~ "Avg. ESS fraction",
                                    "population_ess" ~ "Population ESS fraction")) |>
  ggplot(aes(alpha, ess)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = ess_type, linetype = ess_type),
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(vars(geometry), nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = expansion(),
                     labels = c("0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8", "1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.92, 1)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "22")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c("magenta", "black")])) +
  labs(x = expression(alpha), y = "ESS fraction") +
  plottheme() +
    labs(color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.165, 0.195),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 8, 0, 1),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = 'gray20', linewidth = 0.3))

plot_grid(
  radius_plot,
  risk_plot,
  ess_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  rel_heights = c(0.34, 0.30, 0.36)
)
```
